    Construction phase

      The schedule is the 25011 Function Junction export from Primavera Cloud. Footings, foundation walls, slabs and framing appear level by level on their activity dates, then building paper, cladding and roofing. Building A's framing has an activity per level; B's and C's are split level by level on A's rhythm. C's structure is A's, mirrored. Cranes and logistics zones follow their own dates.

      S rows are site works by others, beyond 1 m from the buildings, and are estimated: early works finish before the first footings, and finishing starts once the roofs are on, in the 2027 paving and planting season. They sweep across the site from west to east. The hatched bands on the timeline mark them.

      From the general contractor's Site Logistics Plan (2026-08-28). Crane bases sit on the outrigger pads drawn on the plan, slewed as in the plan photo. Cranes are drawn to Potain's published data: jib length, height under hook, outrigger base, rear slewing radius and mast size. The swing radius is the jib length. The hatched ring at each base is the rear slewing radius, which must be kept clear.
